description_en: Queries account spending within a billing cycle and aggregates the data by resource owner
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内的消费，并以资源所有者的维度进行汇总

name: QueryAccountBill

parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20. The maximum value is 300
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，默认值20，最大值：300
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to aggregate the results by product code.

true: Results are aggregated by product code.

false: Results are not aggregated by product code.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否增加产品Code汇总。
true。
false。

默认false
parameters.name: is_group_by_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account that owns and actually uses the resource
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The granularity for querying the bill. Valid values:

MONTHLY: Queries bills on a monthly basis. Corresponds to the monthly bills in Expenses & Costs
> Bills
> Bill Details
.

DAILY: Queries bills on a daily basis. Corresponds to the daily bills in Expenses & Costs
> Bills
> Bill Details
.

If you set `Granularity` to `DAILY`, you must also specify the `BillingDate` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值：
MONTHLY：月。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期账单一致。
DAILY：日。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定BillingDate
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when you set Granularity to DAILY. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.help_zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: billing_date
